About

I am a third-year chemistry undergraduate in the Basic Sciences Top Talent Program at Tongji University. Across hybrid metal halides and organic semiconductors, my research centers on rational structure–excited-state engineering: using coordination chemistry, heterometallic coupling, and conformational control to stabilize functional lattices, suppress non-radiative losses, and steer charge carriers toward selective solar-to-chemical and photovoltaic conversion.

At Tongji University, I develop coordination-stabilized metal halides for photocatalysis and luminescence with Prof. Honghan Fei and recently joined Prof. Haotian Wang’s group to explore electrochemical CO2 reduction and molecular electrosynthesis, building on Summer 2026 organic photovoltaic acceptor engineering with Prof. He Yan at HKUST—all anchored by single-crystal crystallography, periodic DFT, and validation-first machine learning.

Publications

Peer-reviewed

Fluorenone Acceptor–Linker Engineering of Lead Halide MOFs for Aerobic Photocatalytic Oxidative Coupling

Dongyang Li, Junkai Kang, Fanyu Meng, Wenyan Dan*, and Honghan Fei*

Inorganic Chemistry 2026, 65 (35), 20401–20410 · Published Aug. 2026

Electronic integration of 1D [Pb2Cl2]2+ chains with fluorenone-2,7-dicarboxylate (TMOF-24 vs. carbonyl-free TMOF-23) shifts absorption from 450 to 535 nm, lowers exciton binding energy, weakens electron–phonon coupling, and sustains quantitative aerobic benzylamine oxidation (>95% yield over ten consecutive cycles).

Article ↗ DOI: 10.1021/acs.inorgchem.6c02797

Technical Background

Synthesis

Schlenk-line & inert-atmosphere techniques; solvothermal & multistep organic synthesis; column chromatography; single-crystal growth.

Characterization

Single-crystal XRD (collection, solution & refinement in Olex2/SHELX), PXRD, NMR, UV–vis & diffuse reflectance, SEM–EDS, enzyme-mimetic kinetics.

Computation & Data

Quantum ESPRESSO (band structures, DOS/PDOS); Python scientific & ML workflows (RDKit, scikit-learn, PyTorch, pandas, NumPy, SciPy); OriginPro, Mercury, ChemDraw, LaTeX.

Academic Community & Service

Peer Mentor at Qidi College supporting junior undergraduates in academic planning and early research onboarding, and Class President of the Chemistry Honors Cohort organizing interdisciplinary student seminars (~200 hours of science outreach and campus service).
